info.title: Refugiapp API
info.description: API para la gestion de refugios de animales.

refreshToken.description: Opaque refresh token for silent rotation. Store it securely on the client.

message.description: Human readable error message or a list of validation messages.

refreshToken.description: The opaque refresh token issued at login or by a previous rotation.

password.description: Plain text password. Never exposed by the API.

roles.description: Roles assigned to the user. Defaults to shelter_manager.

isActive.description: Whether the user account is active.

ownerType.description: Owner entity type. Omit together with ownerId to upload an orphan asset and link it later.

ownerId.description: The UUID of the owner entity. Omit together with ownerType to upload an orphan asset.

recordType.description: Record type. Only sent when it must change.

title.description: Record title (3..160 characters). Only sent when it must change.

occurredAt.description: Date of care. Omit to keep the current value.

veterinarianId.description: Veterinarian responsible for the record. Omit to keep the current value; pass null to unlink the veterinarian.

diagnosis.description: Clinical diagnosis. Omit to keep the current value; pass null to clear it. Empty or whitespace-only strings are stored as null.

treatment.description: Treatment. Omit to keep the current value; pass null to clear it. Empty or whitespace-only strings are stored as null.

notes.description: Notes. Omit to keep the current value; pass null to clear it. Empty or whitespace-only strings are stored as null.

title.description: Task title (3..160 characters). Only sent when it must change.

description.description: Task description. Omit to keep the current value; pass null to clear it. Empty or whitespace-only strings are stored as null.

dueAt.description: Due date. Omit to keep the current value; pass null to clear it.

byStatus.description: Conteo de animales activos por estado; todos los estados del enum estan presentes.

profilePhotoMediaId.description: UUID del asset de media que actua como foto de perfil; null si el animal no tiene foto.

recentAnimals.description: Animales mas recientes para el panel de control.
